m.english: He was arrested, but the charges got dropped.

target.text: Ele foi preso, mas as queixas foram retiradas.

translation.text: He was arrested, but the charges got dropped.

m.target: Ele foi preso, mas as queixas foram retiradas.

m.english: What? Do you complain to me now that nobody takes you seriously?

target.text: O quê, queixas-te a mim que não te levam a sério?

u.english: The students complained because the laughter was so loud nobody could study.

target.text: Houve queixas de alunos, porque era impossível estudar com o riso.

m.english: His wife would not want tobacco growing on their land.

m.english: Tobacco, which might be of some interest to some of you.
